title: The Grammar of Transformers: A Systematic Review of Interpretability Research on Syntactic Knowledge in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.19926v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a systematic review of 337 articles evaluating the syntactic abilities of Transformer-based language models (TLMs), reporting on over 3,000 datapoints spanning a wide range of syntactic phenomena, languages, models, and methods. We take the data to collectively show that TLMs encode a non-trivial amount of syntactic knowledge. Behavioral evidence shows strong performance on formal syntactic phenomena, but weaker and more variable performance on phenomena at the syntax-semantics interface. Performance is also consistently lower for languages with less digital support. Probing and mechanistic studies further support the presence of syntactic knowledge in TLMs. Yet, because most work remains observational and methodologically heterogeneous, insight into the detailed computational mechanisms underlying syntactic processing remains limited. translated_title: Transformer的语法：语言模型句法知识可解释性研究的系统性综述
translated_abstract: 我们对337篇评估基于Transformer的语言模型（TLM）句法能力的文章进行了系统性综述，报告了涵盖广泛句法现象、语言、模型和方法的3000多个数据点。我们认为这些数据共同表明，TLM编码了相当可观的句法知识。行为证据显示，模型在形式句法现象上表现强劲，但在句法-语义界面现象上的表现较弱且波动较大。对于数字化支持较少的语言，模型的表现也始终较低。探针研究和机制研究进一步支持了TLM中存在句法知识这一观点。然而，由于大多数研究仍停留在观察层面且方法上存在异质性，对句法处理背后详细计算机制的深入理解仍然有限。与此同时，文献仍然高度集中于英语和BERT-
tldr: 本文对337篇文献进行系统性综述，证明Transformer语言模型确实编码了可观的句法知识，但在句法-语义界面现象、低资源语言上的表现较弱，且对句法处理的计算机制理解仍然有限。
en_tdlr: This systematic review of 337 articles demonstrates that Transformer language models encode substantial syntactic knowledge, though performance is weaker at the syntax-semantics interface and for less digitally-supported languages, while mechanistic insight into syntactic processing remains limited.
